items.title: Permanent ownership
items.body: We do not buy to sell. When a business joins the group, it stays.

items.title: Craft first
items.body: We are operators, not a fund. We work where we own.

items.title: Long horizons
items.body: Decisions measured in decades, not quarters.

succession.label: SUCCESSION
succession.heading: Continuing what you built.
succession.body: When an owner is ready to step back, we provide a permanent home for the business — the name, the people, and the relationships stay.
succession.note: Conversations are confidential and without obligation. We work alongside your existing advisors.
